title: Takahashi 2006: L4-L5 IDP, standing, 20 deg trunk flexion (forward bending), 5 kg in each hand
condition: standing, 20 deg trunk flexion (forward bending) holding 5 kg in each hand

quantity.name: IDP
quantity.definition: absolute in vivo intradiscal pressure in the nucleus (MPa), peak/plateau value for the posture; mean of 3 subjects

source.authors: Takahashi I, Kikuchi S, Sato K, Sato N
source.sample: 3 healthy subjects (3M); 3 young healthy men, L4-L5 IDP with and without 10 kg

protocol.summary: Needle transducer in the L4-L5 nucleus of 3 young healthy men; upright and 10/20/30 deg forward bending, with and without 10 kg (5 kg per hand).
how_to_simulate: Scale the model to the Takahashi cohort mean (protocol.subject_model: male, 25 y, 176 cm, 72 kg)
Posture: standing, 20 deg trunk flexion (forward bending); arms hanging
Hand load: 10 kg total, 5 kg in each hand, arms hanging at the sides
Output: L4-L5 compression F and L4-L5 intersegmental flexion th
Convert with Ghezelbash 2016 Eq. 6: P = F / A with A = 1970 mm2 (V05 mean) - or 1910 mm2 as in Ghezelbash lab validation targets (Fasser 2021); compare with data[0].mean

subject_model.source: Means computed here from V05 Table 2 (3 men: 26 y/70 kg/170 cm/18.8 cm2; 26 y/70 kg/180 cm/21.2 cm2; 24 y/77 kg/178 cm/19.1 cm2). Bruno 2015 Table 3: 3M, BM 72 kg, HT 176 cm, ages 24-26.
subject_model.disc_area_discrepancy: Ghezelbash lab validation targets (subjects.takahashi) uses 1910 (1730-2120) mm2 from Fasser 2021 Suppl. Table S1 (not verified by the user). V05 Table 2 gives 18.8, 21.2, 19.1 cm2 (mean 19.7 cm2 = 1970 mm2, range 1880-2120). Use 1970 mm2 if following V05; difference 3%.

protocol.idp_conversion: IDP = -1.556e-2 + 1.255 P + 1.243e-2 th + 3.988e-2 P^2 - 1.212e-2 P th + 1.669e-3 th^2 (MPa), P = F_compression / A_disc (MPa = N/mm2), th = L4-L5 intersegmental flexion from upright standing (deg, + flexion). Source: Ghezelbash et al. 2016 Biomech Model Mechanobiol 15:1699, Eq. 6 (U01 p.10; quadratic fit to the Shirazi-Adl 2006 L4-L5 FE model, R2 0.999, RMSE 0.025 MPa; derived with that model's disc area 1455 mm2, applied with the subject's own area); used again as Eq. 1-2 in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 J Biomech 102:109550 and in the Ghezelbash lab MSK validation. Sensitivity alternative: classical Nachemson factor IDP = F / (0.66 A) (Bruno et al. 2015 J Biomech Eng Eq. 2; Dreischarf 2016 V05 uses F = 0.66 IDP A).
protocol.notes: Task set and hand load (5 kg in each hand at the side) confirmed by Bruno 2015 J Biomech Eng Table 3 (M01.pdf). Only group means are published (V05: 'only mean published').

data.x: standing, 20 deg trunk flexion (forward bending) + 5 kg/hand
data.load: 10 kg total, 5 kg in each hand, arms hanging at the sides

extraction.from: Ghezelbash lab validation targets (Ghezelbash lab validation targets) (tak_flex20_10kg; digitised from Ghezelbash 2020 J Biomech Fig 4a), original Takahashi et al. 2006 Spine 31:18 (figures)
extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.01 MPa (digitisation) on top of the secondary-source uncertainty
extraction.check_notes: Original PDF not available. Independently re-digitised the same measured bar in Ghezelbash 2020 Fig S2-3a (accepted manuscript p.40, 300 dpi): 1.16 vs targets 1.166 MPa (diff 0.006 MPa, within the +/-0.01 MPa + bar-outline width).

pass_rule.rule: pass if |model - measured| <= max(SD or half-range, 0.26 x measured); pooled over all L4-L5 tasks R2 >= 0.78 with slope 95% CI containing 1 and intercept CI containing 0
pass_rule.source: Ghezelbash lab validation targets tolerance_policy.idp_task / idp_aggregate (CV_pool 0.26 = pooled between-subject CV of Sato 1999's 8 healthy subjects)
